roles.name: Super Admin
roles.description: Complete unrestricted administrative control across all modules, users, security, and settings.

roles.name: COO
roles.description: Chief Operating Officer with full operational, financial, and reporting oversight.

roles.name: Sales Manager
roles.description: Manages sales team pipeline, orders, client accounts, and revenue performance.

roles.name: Sales Officer
roles.description: Handles client bookings. Strictly restricted to view and edit only assigned orders.

roles.name: Finance Manager
roles.description: Controls company expenses, cost approvals, vendor receipts, and resource payout settlements.

roles.name: Project Manager
roles.description: Oversees project delivery milestones, production progress, and worker payout allocations.

roles.name: Employee
roles.description: Internal team member or contractor with restricted access to assigned tasks and payout records.

roles.name: Viewer
roles.description: Read-only stakeholder with view permissions on high-level operational dashboards and reports.
